record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare FLAMETHROWER: Magby (1 star), Magmar (2) and Magmortar (3); maxPP 80, range 2 and passive NONE for all in the catalog. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (damage table index). The registered class is FlameThrowerStrategy in flame-thrower.ts (the identifier is FLAMETHROWER).
record.summary: A ray in the direction of the cast target (one of 8 directions chosen by the signs of the caster-to-target offset, so any off-axis target becomes a diagonal) that reaches at most 3 cells from the caster (Chebyshev distance). Every enemy unit standing on those cells takes SPECIAL damage (raw 30/60/120 by the caster's stars, AP-scaled, crit only with ABILITY_CRIT) and then a 4000 ms burn with the caster as origin. Allies on the ray are skipped and do not block it; empty cells are visited but do nothing. If no enemy was found on the ray (for example the target is off the ray because of the direction rounding or farther than 3 cells), the effect is applied once to the cast target's own cell, so the target is damaged and burned regardless of range and direction. In the RIGHT direction the loop bound is board.rows (read as written), which with the 3-cell limit does not shorten the ray unless the caster stands in column 3 or beyond on the 8 x 6 board.

targeting.who: every enemy unit on the ray cells within 3 cells of the caster; otherwise the cast target
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; the direction comes from the cast target's position relative to the caster.

geometry.shape: straight ray (UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT or one of four diagonals) from the cell next to the caster, limited to Chebyshev distance 3, board edges end it; the RIGHT direction uses board.rows as its bound

effects.target: each enemy unit on the ray within range 3 (or the cast target if none was found)
effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) per enemy (apBoost default true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by each target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit, which requires EffectEnum.ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false
effects.resolution: requested amount per enemy = raw x AP factor [x crit]; then the enemy's SPE_DEF division (ceil, min 1) and untraced later modifiers, so it is an intermediate calculation, not the final HP loss; takenDamage (not used, the return value is discarded) would count HP removed plus shield damage. Blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce on that enemy (takes 0, the burn is still attempted); a magicBounce enemy also queues a delayed SPECIAL bounce at the caster unless it holds Protective Pads. Each enemy is hit once per cast.

statusEffects.target: each enemy hit (same set as the damage)
statusEffects.scaling: none from AP or crit, none from stars
statusEffects.applicationOrder: right after that enemy's damage call
statusEffects.guards: not applied if the enemy has IMMUNITY_BURN, Rune Protect or the WATER_BUBBLE passive. When applied, the duration goes through applyStatusDurationReductions with the burning enemy as the entity (the supplied pkm is cell.value): the target-side reductions apply, not the caster's. A new duration replaces the timer and the origin only if it is longer than the remaining burn. Burn is applied even if protect / skydiving / magicBounce made the damage 0.
statusEffects.combatEffect: each second the burning unit takes TRUE damage of 5% of its max HP (rounded), reduced by weather (rain x0.7; drought x1.3 with Heat Rock reduction), Assault Vest x0.5, Swift Swim / Hydration / Water Veil / Surge Surfer, and set to 0 with WELL_BAKED or Magmarizer; the damage is attributed to the burn origin (the caster). Only the tick function was cited; other readers of the burn flag were not searched.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the three listed units are 1-3 stars, so their bare values are 30/60/120. The 240 value (4th column and fallback) is not reachable by their bare star counts. The 4000 ms burn does not vary with stars.

record.positionalConditions: Which enemies are hit depends on the caster and target coordinates: the 8-way direction (sign-based), the ray within 3 cells (Chebyshev), and the RIGHT bound quirk. With no enemy on the ray the cast target is hit anyway. Allies on the ray are ignored.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast repeats the damage and renews the burn only if the new 4000 ms is longer than what remains.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 30/60/120 (1/2/3 stars) per enemy on the ray; burn 4000 ms (requested). Requested damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor]; then the SPE_DEF division (ceil, min 1) and untraced modifiers (intermediate, not final HP loss). Burn: requested 4000 ms, applied after the target-side duration reductions; its later per-second damage is 5% of the burning unit's max HP (true damage, modified as listed) and is not part of the cast's damage.
